headline: Iran vows to use all available means against the US naval blockade, calling it military aggression
label: NEWS
caption:
Iran says it will no longer tolerate the US blockade. 🚢

Iran's Foreign Ministry spokesman Esmaeil Baghaei said on Monday that Tehran "will use all available means to counter US aggression", Al Jazeera reported, citing AFP and Reuters.

Baghaei described US sanctions, the economic blockade and the naval blockade as an act of military aggression against Iran, citing Article 51 of the UN Charter on self defence.

He said the Strait of Hormuz could be reopened within two days if Washington halts hostilities, lifts the blockade and waives sanctions.

The US first imposed the blockade on Iranian ports in April, lifted it in June after a draft understanding, and restored it on July 14 when that agreement collapsed.

Visible Iranian crude exports have fallen to near zero in recent months, and more than 80 percent of Iran's trade passes through Hormuz or its southern ports, according to Al Jazeera.
